subject: SyncScribe pilot: budget, token sizing, and commit incentive follow-up
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Sara Harris <sara.harris@syncscribe.com>, Alex Gomez <alexg@syncscribe.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-01T16:10:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo: quick budget & token-sizing questions + next steps

Hi Sara / Alex —

Thanks again for the demo time today — appreciated the level of detail on the transcription + reranking flows. A couple quick items so we can put a concrete pilot offer together and validate if the startup program / commit incentives make sense for SyncScribe: 

1) Token volume profile: can you confirm expected steady-state monthly usage (prompt vs completion split if available) for the pilot and 12‑month projection? In our scoping call you mentioned a pilot ~25–40M tokens/month, ramping to ~120–180M/month at scale — please confirm ranges.

2) Budget bands: what’s the monthly budget range you have in mind for the first 3–6 months and for steady state? (ballpark is fine). This helps us pick the right committed tier to model unit economics.

3) Target $/1M tokens: do you have an internal target price per 1M tokens we should try to hit with discounts? If you prefer ranges, that’s fine — e.g., $800–$1,200 / 1M tokens is a typical way customers express it.

4) Discount path: you mentioned eligibility for a startup program and interest in a committed-use discount if you commit 12 months. We can lay out a startup promo + one or two committed tiers with multi-year incentives — please confirm whether procurement prefers monthly invoicing vs. prepay/annual invoicing.

Attachments: I’m attaching a usage worksheet we can co-edit plus a draft commit offer (PDF) so you have a straw-man.

Next steps: if you can reply with the three data points above, I’ll get Ben to price two options (startup promo vs. 12‑month commit) and push a concise MAP (mutual action plan) with legal/PO timelines.

Thanks —
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com
+1 415 555 0198

Attachments: 20260801-usage-forecast.xlsx, redwood-commit-offer-v1.pdf

From: Sara Harris <sara.harris@syncscribe.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Gomez <alexg@syncscribe.com>
Date: 2026-08-01T17:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: quick budget & token-sizing questions + next steps

Hi Neha —

Great recap — quick answers below to keep momentum: 

1) Token volumes: pilot (first 60–90 days): 30–45M tokens/month. We estimate ~60/40 prompt:completion split. 12‑month target: 140–180M tokens/month if the accuracy and latency targets hold.

2) Budget bands: pilot budget is modest — $20k–$40k/mo. If we move to a production contract, budget expectation is $80k–$150k/mo over year 1 depending on uptake.

3) Target $/1M tokens: we’re aiming for a unit economic target around $900–$1,100 per 1M tokens (closer to $1,000 if possible). That’s the number we’d need to make the business case for the initial production rollout.

4) Discount path & procurement: we’re an early-stage company (Series A) and would love to see startup program terms first. Procurement is open to annual invoicing if there’s a material discount; otherwise monthly is preferred during pilot. Our procurement timeline is ~3–4 weeks once we choose an offer.

Thanks — copying Alex for any technical clarifications.

—Sara
Sara Harris
Head of Product, SyncScribe
sara.harris@syncscribe.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sara Harris <sara.harris@syncscribe.com>
Date: 2026-08-02T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Post-demo: quick budget & token-sizing questions + next steps

Neha / team —

Thanks for the update and the numbers from SyncScribe. Based on Sara’s ranges I recommend we present two clean options to them (keep messaging simple):

Option A — Startup Promo (low-friction pilot)
- Eligibility: SyncScribe qualifies (early-stage).
- Term: 3 months trial + 3 months discounted runway.
- Commercial: $200k credit bucket applied to usage across first 3 months; up to 30% off list for months 4–6 capped at 100M tokens/mo.
- Billing: monthly invoicing; option to switch to annual prepay if they want additional credits.
- Good if they want to minimize procurement friction and validate model fit.

Option B — 12-month Committed Use (production path)
- Commitment bands (monthly equivalent):
  • Tier 1: 50M tokens/mo commit — 20% off base list price
  • Tier 2: 150M tokens/mo commit — 30% off base list price
  • Tier 3: 300M tokens/mo commit — 35–40% off + additional compute credits (multi‑year upside)
- Multi-year incentive: sign a 24‑month agreement with a 12‑month prepay = extra 5% credit applied to monthly billing.
- Estimated unit economics: with Sara’s target ($1,000 / 1M tokens list target), Tier 2 gets to ~ $700 / 1M after 30% off and typical batching/kv-cache savings.
- Billing: we can support monthly invoicing or annual prepay (finance prefers annual for larger credits).

Ask for Legal / Procurement: we’ll include a short SOW and a simple procurement addendum. Marissa, can you draft the PO-ready language and the pricing table for the two options? I’ll prepare the short MAP and propose dates for procurement milestones (signature target within 3–4 weeks).

Neha — suggest we send the two-option PDF + MAP to SyncScribe today; call out the $/1M examples so they can see how the math lands against their $900–$1,100 target.

Ben
Ben Carter
Sales Lead, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Sara Harris <sara.harris@syncscribe.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-02T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: SyncScribe next steps + MAP and offer (two options)

Sara —

Appreciate the timely details. I’ve attached a short two-option offer (startup promo vs 12‑month commit) and a one-page MAP that lays out milestones and the typical procurement timeline. Quick summary:

- Startup Promo: lowest procurement friction, $200k trial credit, and month 4–6 discount band aimed at letting you validate accuracy/latency without committing up front.
- 12‑month Commit: tiered discounts (20% / 30% / 35–40%), optional 24‑month/annual prepay incentives, and an estimate that Tier 2 (~150M/mo) lands closer to your $1,000 target when combined with our runtime savings.

Next asks from SyncScribe to finalize price: 
1) Confirm whether you want us to price Tier 1 vs Tier 2 (we can show a blended example for the pilot ramp).
2) Confirm preferred billing cadence (monthly invoicing vs annual prepay).
3) Procurement milestone: can you confirm an internal decision date (aiming for signature by 2026-09-01 would keep us on a familiar timeline).

If that works I’ll get Ben to drop the finalized pricing table and Marissa to attach the PO-ready language.

Thanks again —
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com
+1 415 555 0198

Attachments: redwood-commit-offer-v1.pdf, 20260801-usage-forecast.xlsx
